title: Asymptotic strictness conjecture for the type of numerical monoids
statement:
Let $\mathscr{T}(e,m)$ and $\mathscr{D}(e,m)$ denote the functions defined in the paper for the type and the relevant upper bound of numerical monoids. **Asymptotic strictness conjecture.** For any fixed value of $e\geq 3$, one has

$$
\mathscr{T}(e,m)<\mathscr{D}(e,m)
$$

for $m\gg0$. The conjecture proposes that the upper bound for the type is eventually not attained, in analogy with the corresponding asymptotic result for the related function; the preceding corollaries establish equality in several other regimes, but the stated asymptotic strict inequality remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.19810

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of May 2024).
source_name: Alessio Moscariello and Alessio Sammartano, “On minimal presentations of numerical monoids”, arXiv:2405.19810 (2024).
